mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate signals monetary policy tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 380000 indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 380000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production below its 3-month moving average signals weakening economic momentum and increased recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation consistent with strong economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month non-farm payrolls growth above 0.5% indicates robust labor market conditions that support immediate consumer spending and corporate hiring, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate above its 5-year average reflects strong economic expansion that boosts corporate profit visibility, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds its 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 110.0 (index, 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 110.0.
